holes.name: First Flight
holes.description: A gentle opener. Fairway bunkers pinch the landing area; the green is guarded left and right.

holes.name: The Dogleg
holes.description: Doglegs hard left around a corner bunker. Cut too much off and the trees wait.

holes.name: Pond Hop
holes.description: All carry over the pond to a green that tilts back toward the water.

holes.name: Long Haul
holes.description: The long par five. A creek crosses the fairway just past driving distance: lay up or carry it.

holes.name: Lakeside
holes.description: A lake runs the whole left side and the green leans toward it. Bail out right.

holes.name: Little Sting
holes.description: Short, but the green is ringed by four bunkers. Precision over power.

holes.name: Wingspan
holes.description: A long dogleg right. The inside corner bunker rewards a brave line.

holes.name: Marsh Run
holes.description: A three-shotter past a marsh pond, finishing at a green with water short and right.

holes.name: Home Stretch
holes.description: A cross bunker splits the fairway on the way home to a big, fast green.
